featured_reviews.name: Hirali Sanghani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited the jewellery store, and I had an absolutely wonderful experience. From the moment I walked in, the hospitality was exceptional, and I felt genuinely welcomed.
Ruchika Ambekar and Riddhi Upadhyay were especially helpful. They patiently listened to what I was looking for, guided me through options, and helped me customize a piece to exactly match my vision. Their expertise and kindness made the entire process so much easier and more enjoyable.
A big thank you also to Pratik and Asha (from the orders department) — your support in making sure I got exactly what I wanted was invaluable.
I also want to highlight the warm and caring service in the store’s pantry, particularly Rekha ji, who served food with such love and graciousness. It was a small touch, but it made the visit feel even more special.
Overall, I highly recommend this jewellery store — not just for the beautiful pieces, but for the outstanding customer service. I will definitely be coming back!

The showroom maintains excellent standards of cleanliness and customer service, creating a welcoming and trustworthy atmosphere. I would highly recommend Tanishq Borivali to anyone looking for quality jewellery, transparency, and a memorable shopping experience.☺️✨

featured_reviews.name: Satish Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: "I had an excellent experience at Tanishq borivali showroom. The entire team was extremely professional, courteous, and customer-focused. All the RSOs (Retail Sales Officers) were highly knowledgeable, well-behaved, and always willing to assist with patience and genuine care. I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for premium jewellery, especially for weddings

featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent customer service and complete transparency at Tanishq Jewellery - Mumbai -borivali  The Diamond Experience Centre gave us proper knowledge about diamonds, which removed all our hesitation before buying. We were also impressed with the transparent gold exchange evaluation and clear communication throughout the process. The trusted Tata name itself gives peace of mind and confidence in the purchase. Special thanks to all the team member for their warm hospitality and guidance.

featured_reviews.name: Harsh Thakkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Tanishq being a Tata brand has that always gained that confidence in us and we had a wonderful shopping experience at Tanishq, Borivali West. The staff - Dhanashree, Siddhesh, Sachin, Mayna and Pintoo - all were extremely courteous, patient, and helpful throughout the purchase process in their respective roles. They explained every design and detail very well, without making us feel rushed. Their professionalism and warm hospitality truly made the experience special. featured_reviews.name: Yash Savle
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited the Tanishq store in Borivali West after being specifically referred here by the Goregaon store, as this location is larger and supposedly offers a wider variety of ring collections. Unfortunately, this turned out to be a complete waste of time.

The staff was shockingly disinterested and unprofessional. The person assigned to assist us made zero effort to understand our preferences or show designs based on what we clearly requested. Instead, he casually dumped ring racks on the table and walked away, leaving us to browse on our own. Most of the rings weren’t even available in proper sizes, showing a clear lack of concern for customers.

Basic customer service was completely missing. No water, no refreshments, no engagement—despite us spending a considerable amount of time in the store. We were repeatedly ignored, which is unacceptable for any store, let alone a so-called premium brand like Tanishq.

When shopping for something as important and expensive as diamond rings, customers expect professionalism, attention, and respect. This store delivered none of that. The experience was drastically worse compared to other Tanishq outlets like Goregaon , Andheri (Lokhandwala), where service standards are far superior.

Overall, this store reflects extremely poor staff attitude and weak management oversight. I strongly do NOT recommend this location and sincerely hope the management takes corrective action, because this level of service seriously damages the brand’s reputation.

featured_reviews.name: Saakshi Agarwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been an old Tanishq customer, but recently I had the opportunity to interact with their Diamond Expertise team—especially Mr. Deepak—and it was genuinely such a great experience.

I really appreciated how patiently and transparently he explained the details of the diamonds in my mangalsutra. I actually walked away learning the three key things that determine diamond clarity: the number of marks/inclusions, the size of those marks, and their location within the diamond.

As a millennial, I’m always skeptical when it comes to buying diamonds anywhere, so this kind of education and transparency builds immense trust. I’d genuinely recommend people engage with their diamond experts—not just to shop, but to become more informed buyers. Awareness like this is what will slowly push dishonest practices out of the market.

Amazing initiative by Tata and Tanishq! ✨

featured_reviews.name: Heena P
featured_reviews.review_text: If you want to save your money, do not visit this place. Better to buy than rent. Firstly, it's not as cheap - the rent for a basic set is around 2.3 k with a deposit around 5.5k plus the hassle of traveling to and fro to the shop, around your special day, is not  very convenient. On top of that the owner demands more than 70 percent as advance. Our wedding got postponed due to covid and the lady did not consider adjusting our refund for hiring jewelry on the rescheduled date. Her condition was that the wedding should happen within next 45 days only then we can rent the jewelry - as if we can control the pandemic!  We didn't ask her for a complete refund but atleast a partial refund or the flexibility to hire jewelry on a later date, but she began saying that I'll have to again incur additional charges on the later date. She unjustly enriched our money and has no regrets - as she abruptly hung up our call. I won't be surprised if she refutes our claim. Stay away and buy jewelry instead or look for other places to rent.

featured_reviews.review_text: The ornaments are really very good well polished and in good condition and it goes very well with the other gold jewellery.
